module_title: Standard Field Pitches and Court Dimensions
introduction: This level highlights the physical dimensions (lengths, widths, net heights) of mainstream sports pitches and courts. These questions are highly popular in executive level tests like SSC CPO and CGL.

core_concepts.title: Cricket Pitch and Marathon Distances
core_concepts.description:
1. **Cricket Pitch Length:** Measured strictly from wicket to wicket. It is **22 Yards** (66 feet). In meters, this equates precisely to **20.12 meters**.
2. **Standard Marathon Distance:** The official distance is **42.195 Kilometers** or 26 miles 385 yards.

core_concepts.title: Badminton Court Specifications
core_concepts.description:
1. **Singles Court:** 13.40 meters (44 ft) in length × 5.18 meters (17 ft) in width.
2. **Doubles Court:** 13.40 meters (44 ft) in length × 6.10 meters (20 ft) in width.
3. **Net Height:** 1.55 meters (5 ft 1 inch) at the edges and 1.524 meters (5 ft) at the center.

core_concepts.title: Volleyball and Basketball Courts
core_concepts.description:
1. **Volleyball Court:** Measures precisely **18 meters × 9 meters**. (The length is exactly twice the width, forming two perfect 9x9 meter halves).
2. **Basketball Court:** Measures precisely **28 meters × 15 meters** according to FIBA (International Basketball Federation) standards.

important_entities.name: Lawn Tennis Court
important_entities.significance: A tennis court's length is universally constant at 23.77 meters (78 feet). However, the width shifts based on format: 8.23 meters (27 feet) for Singles and 10.97 meters (36 feet) for Doubles.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: In MCQs about cricket pitch length, options will include both '22 Meters' and '22 Yards'. Excited students often pick meters by mistake. Always check the unit—it is **22 Yards**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Visualize the volleyball court as two adjacent squares of 9m × 9m. Put them together, and you get the standard 18m × 9m layout instantly.

exam_strategy_tips: An executive Tier-2 favorite: 'What is the exact distance of an official Olympic standard marathon race?' Answer: 42.195 km.
